phases.name: Winter
actions: Year-end reflection and plan for next year

plan_blueprint.calendar: A weekly hold on the chosen night, an idea card two days ahead, and a childcare reminder when needed. Seasons start from your start date.

approach_variants.habit: Same night every week; streak of weeks with a date.
approach_variants.willpower: Seasonal challenge: try one brand-new thing each month.
approach_variants.time: Date night plus 10 minutes of planning as calendar blocks.
approach_variants.reward: Every 10 dates unlocks a bigger date you've both picked.
approach_variants.resource: First week lines up a babysitter list, a budget and a shared ideas list.

guardrails: GoalKin offers prompts and planning, not counselling or therapy. If things feel stuck or painful, a licensed counsellor can help.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A missed week moves the idea to the next week; no guilt. Two missed weeks suggest a 20-minute at-home date to restart.

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
